description: Invite someone to an organization (the team). Provide an email to invite a specific person (if they already have a Dock account they're added immediately; otherwise a magic-link invite is emailed), or omit the email to create a shareable open-link invite. Optionally set role (admin or member, default member), expires_in_days, and max_uses (open-link only). Returns whether a member was added immediately or an invite is pending, plus the accept URL for link invites. AGENTS: you may invite one person by email, as a member only, when their email domain is the same as your organization owner's (not a public mail domain like gmail.com), it is your own organization, and your owner is an owner or admin of it; open links and the admin role are refused. Tell your owner whenever you invite someone.

email.description: Email to invite. Omit to create an open-link invite.

expires_in_days.description: Days until the invite expires. Omit for no expiry (open-link) or the 7-day default (email).

max_uses.description: Max accepts for an open-link invite. Omit for unlimited.

name: invite_to_org
